display.title: Our Secret Weapon: How Tzivos Hashem Defeats the Yetzer Hara
display.summary_short: Members of Tzivos Hashem fight one enemy, the yetzer hara, and every bit of Torah and mitzvos weakens it until it surrenders, just in time to greet Moshiach.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi tells children that belonging to Hashem's army means being united with thousands of Jewish children around the world in doing good: learning more Torah and doing more mitzvos than ever before. That is how the battle is won. The enemy is not a person but our own yetzer hara, the little voice that tempts us to do wrong. The more Torah we learn and the more mitzvos we do, the weaker it gets, until it gives up and says, 'You win, members of Tzivos Hashem.' Torah and mitzvos are our secret weapon, and there is no nicer way to greet Moshiach, who is on his way, than with a total victory over the yetzer hara.
display.lesson: Every bit of Torah and every mitzvah weakens the yetzer hara; together we can win the battle.

date.note: Inherits the air date of episode 184 (45e5fe6378). Episode: 'In the middle of the Three Weeks'; the week after episode 183 (13 Tammuz 5745). Most of the content repeats episode 135 (Three Weeks 5744).

quality.notes: Evergreen Tzivos Hashem talk, re-aired many times.
